quality_reasoning: This is a clean, well-structured implementation. The envelope CLI is its own module, the store keeps envelopes and transactions side by side (a real data-loss risk the agent caught and disclosed), and the tests cover the model, the allocation tie-break, validation errors, close-month and a CSV round-trip. One small risk: if `load` reads `payload["transactions"]` strictly, a store created only through `envelope add` could crash status, alerts and close-month. Out-of-range `--month` values also silently produce odd results, although the report discloses this.
